bundle.shortDescription: Tabulect — local ingest, OCR, and a reading table.
bundle.longDescription: Tabulect reads PDF, EPUB, HTML, MD, and DOCX on 127.0.0.1:8755, OCRs scanned PDFs locally (tur+eng), and fills the locked table schema through a signed-in subscription CLI. No API keys. No cloud OCR.
